characters.name: JUKU
characters.description: Väike 5-aastane poiss tumeblondide lühikeste juustega, seljas punane villane kampsun ja sinised püksid. Sõbralik rõõmsameelne näoilme, suured säravad silmad. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: LIISA
characters.description: Väike 5-aastane tüdruk kahe heleda patsi, rohelise kampsuni ja kollase seelikuga. Rõõmus naeratus, uudishimulikud silmad. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Kodu veranda
locations.description: Cozy indoor wooden porch with light pine walls, natural wooden floor, single large glass window on back wall showing an autumn garden, small light wood table in center, light sunlight streaming inside. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: Sunny autumn garden with green grass scattered with yellow and orange fallen leaves, big sturdy oak tree in center with brown branches, wooden fence in background under blue sky. Bright cartoon style.

pages.scene: Inside cozy indoor wooden porch with light pine walls and wooden floor. Juku (boy in red sweater) and Liisa (girl in green sweater with braids) stand next to a large glass window, looking outside through the window at tiny birds fluttering outdoors. Juku points toward the window glass, away from Liisa. Sunlight warms the porch. Juku: boy with short dark-blond hair, red knitted sweater, blue trousers. Liisa: girl with two light blonde braids, green sweater, yellow skirt. There is no birdhouse in this picture yet. The illustration fills the whole frame edge to edge, no band, strip or empty area at the bottom.

Inside the wooden porch, Juku and Liisa stand by the small wooden table in the center of the room. They look at each other with happy excited expressions and raised hands, having a bright idea. The large window is behind them. Juku: boy with short dark-blond hair, red knitted sweater, blue trousers. Liisa: girl with two light blonde braids, green sweater, yellow skirt. There is no birdhouse in this picture yet. The illustration fills the whole frame edge to edge, no band, strip or empty area at the bottom.

On the wooden porch, Liisa stands by the wooden table holding up a small clean wooden birdhouse box with a small entrance hole. Juku stands beside her looking happy and clapping his hands. Juku: boy with short dark-blond hair, red knitted sweater, blue trousers. Liisa: girl with two light blonde braids, green sweater, yellow skirt. The birdhouse is a small wooden box with a closed front wall, one round entrance hole and a small sloped roof. The illustration fills the whole frame edge to edge, no band, strip or empty area at the bottom.

On the wooden porch table, the small wooden birdhouse sits open. Juku tips a small ceramic bowl and sunflower seeds pour from the bowl into the round entrance hole of the wooden birdhouse box. Liisa stands next to him watching closely with a cheerful smile. Juku: boy with short dark-blond hair, red knitted sweater, blue trousers. Liisa: girl with two light blonde braids, green sweater, yellow skirt. The birdhouse is a small wooden box with a closed front wall, one round entrance hole and a small sloped roof. The illustration fills the whole frame edge to edge, no band, strip or empty area at the bottom.

The small wooden birdhouse stands on the wooden porch table. Juku holds it steady with both hands while Liisa ties a short brown string loop (as small as a hand) onto the top of its roof. The string is short and ends at the roof; nothing hangs from the ceiling and no rope comes from above. Both children look focused and happy. Juku: boy with short dark-blond hair, red knitted sweater, blue trousers. Liisa: girl with two light blonde braids, green sweater, yellow skirt. The birdhouse is a small wooden box with a closed front wall, one round entrance hole and a small sloped roof. The illustration fills the whole frame edge to edge, no band, strip or empty area at the bottom.

Outside in the sunny autumn garden with yellow and orange leaves on the grass. Juku walks across the grass carrying the small wooden birdhouse in both arms against his chest; its short string loop sits on the roof and does not reach the tree. Liisa walks happily beside him, side by side, both heading towards a big oak tree in the background. Juku: boy with short dark-blond hair, red knitted sweater, blue trousers. Liisa: girl with two light blonde braids, green sweater, yellow skirt. The birdhouse is a small wooden box with a closed front wall, one round entrance hole and a small sloped roof. The illustration fills the whole frame edge to edge, no band, strip or empty area at the bottom.

In the autumn garden under the big oak tree. Liisa stands on tip-toe reaching up to hang the rope of the wooden birdhouse onto a low sturdy tree branch. Juku stands next to her supporting the birdhouse gently. Juku: boy with short dark-blond hair, red knitted sweater, blue trousers. Liisa: girl with two light blonde braids, green sweater, yellow skirt. The birdhouse is a small wooden box with a closed front wall, one round entrance hole and a small sloped roof. In the autumn garden, the wooden birdhouse is hanging securely from the tree branch. Two tiny cute songbirds are perched on the birdhouse itself, at its entrance hole, eating seeds. Juku and Liisa stand on the grass below, watching quietly with happy smiles. Juku: boy with short dark-blond hair, red knitted sweater, blue trousers. In the autumn garden, Juku and Liisa stand side by side under the tree with colourful autumn leaves on the ground. They face the viewer and smile warmly at the reader, waving.
